question: How many students has AIMS-Cameroon trained under its Master of Science in Mathematics and Cooperative Master Programs, per the October 2023 signing?
answer: Nearly 450 students from 27 African countries have been trained in the Master of Science in Mathematics and Cooperative Master Programs, of whom 37% are women and 46% are Cameroonian.
